entities.summary: Tite Kubo (b. 1977-06-26, Fuchū-chō) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Fuchū-chō and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
